descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在雅典做的纸菜单，绿色馅料旁边有一把终于放平的叉子。
descriptions.en: My Athens paper menu shows green filling beside a fork that can finally lie flat.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 这张自制菜单把蜂蜜留在纸上的点心旁，杯柄保持干净。
descriptions.en: This homemade menu keeps the honey beside the paper sweets and off the cup handle.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在鸭池边站远看过以后，我折的小纸鸭，没有取用羽毛。
descriptions.en: My little paper duck was folded after watching from a distance; no feathers were collected.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在雅典剪的圆纸签，边缘缺口记着那颗挡路的小石子。
descriptions.en: My round Athens paper tab has a notch for the little stone that stopped the wagon.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我自己折的纸鞋，掀开能看见铺平的纸鞋垫。
descriptions.en: My folded paper shoe opens to reveal a neatly flattened paper insole.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 离开鸭池后做的活动纸卡，两条纸包带可以各自摆动。
descriptions.en: A moving paper card I made after the duck pond visit, with two independently swinging paper straps.
